about.title: Our Story
about.intro: Sauti Nyikani Church is part of the Evangelical Mission Church family, rooted in the Word of God and committed to raising a Christ-centered community in Mubende and beyond.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To proclaim the Gospel of Jesus Christ, disciple believers, and serve our community with love and compassion.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: A church where every generation grows in faith, and every voice carries the Gospel to the nations.

items.title: The Bible
items.desc: We believe the Bible is the inspired, authoritative Word of God.

items.title: Salvation
items.desc: We believe salvation is by grace through faith in Jesus Christ alone.

items.title: Community
items.desc: We believe the church is a family called to love and serve one another.

items.title: Mission
items.desc: We believe every believer is called to share the Gospel locally and globally.

leadership.title: Our Leadership
leadership.text: Our pastoral team is committed to shepherding this congregation with wisdom, humility, and a deep love for God's people.

bibleCta.title: Read The Bible
bibleCta.text: Dive into God's Word in English, French, or Kiswahili, right here on our website.
